<thought>Based on the 13C and 1H NMR data, the compound matches phenylacetone (C₉H₁₀O) with a carbonyl at ~169 ppm, a benzylic CH₂ at ~43 ppm, a methyl attached to the carbonyl at ~26 ppm, and an aromatic ring. The SMILES for phenylacetone is CC(=O)Cc1ccccc1.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)Cc1ccccc1</final_answer>
